_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. DoorDash's consumer web declares the prism token system on :where(.prism-theme): --base-* primitives (brand/hue/neutral colour ramps, a DD Norms type scale, a 32-step size scale, weights, tracking, leading), --usage-* semantic roles aliasing them, and --comp-* component tokens aliasing the roles. The surface paints light only. Declared variables become var leaves (resolved values) or {path} leaves when the winning declaration is a plain var() alias of a token with the same resolved value; measured leaves come from raw/components-computed.json.

color.$description: The prism --base-color-* ramps: the doordash, caviar and dashpass brand palettes; neutral and warm/cool greys on a 0-100 scale (with half-steps 15/25/…/95); twelve hue ramps; plus black and white.

font.$description: DD Norms (proprietary, served from web-assets.cdn4dd.com) over the system stack: --base-font-* families (default = brand = DD Norms, condensed for campaign display), the --base-font-size-* 28-step scale in px, weights 300-800, leading and tracking.

motion.$description: The --usage-motion-* ladder: auto/functional durations, cubic-bezier easings, delays and the pressed scale.

size.$description: The --base-size-* 32-step dimension scale (px) every space/size/radius role aliases.

radius.$description: The --usage-border-radius-* roles (none → full), aliases over the base size scale — DoorDash pills use radius-full.

spacing.$description: The --usage-space-* semantic spacing steps (none → xxx-large), aliases over the base size scale.

typography.$description: The prism type roles (usage-type-*): body, display (condensed for campaign headlines), label, link and title, each in large/medium/small and emphasis variants, on DD Norms weights 400-800.

text.source: css-var --comp-color-chat-message-outbound-text declared on `:where(.prism-theme)` → `var(--usage-color-text-inverse-default)` (prism alias)

comp.$description: The --comp-* component token layer (button, field, tag, toggle, switch, banner, avatar, list, map, pagination, quantity-stepper, side-navigation, table, toast, tooltip, chat, date-picker, progress) — every name an alias down the prism chain.

color.$description: The --usage-color-* semantic roles: text/background/border/icon/action with default-hovered-pressed-disabled states, status (positive/negative/warning/highlight/selected), deal/dashpass/safedash brand roles, media/map/data-viz/overlay surfaces — aliases over the base ramps.

type.$description: The --usage-type-* per-role slots the core.typography composites are built from, plus the generic --usage-font-*/-line-height-*/-letter-spacing-* type aliases (all aliasing the base scale).

size.$description: The --usage-size-* sizing scale plus the action-* control heights.

component.$description: Measured on the public components (raw/components-computed.json): the painted geometry the --comp-* token layer produces on the signed-out surface.
